Public Health Electives
Public Health Electives (9 credits): Approved courses include: AMDT 317; ANTH 203, 205, 220, 268, 302, 304, 316, 350; BIOLOGY 307, 333, 340, 370, 395, 418, 469, 579; COM 471; COMHLTH 571, 572, 573, 574; CRM J 205, 330, 365, 380; H D 220, 300, 301, 302, 307, 310, 385, 403, 406, 410, 418, 430, 482; ENGLISH 310; ENTOM 340, 361, 448, 490; MBIOS 306, 320, 405, 410, 442, 446, 478, 548; MGMT 301; PHIL 365; PSYCH 230, 265, 310, 320, 372, 390; SOC 300, 310, 317, 320, 344, 340, 351, 367, 368, 536; PUBHLTH 499; SOIL SCI 568; WGSS 120, 300, 307. Other courses may be allowed by department consent. Courses may not be used to fulfill more than one requirement. Please see your advisor.

Electives
Electives: 300- or 400-level coursework as needed to meet University requirements of 120 credits and 40 upper-division credits.

Students may be admitted to the Public Health major, Infectious Disease option upon making their intention known to the department and completion of 24 credits with a 2.0 GPA.  This option is available on the Pullman campus.
